name: Ravagers' Devil's Food Chocolate Cake & Collector's Warm Apple Crisp (Marvel Day at Sea)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Marvel Day at Sea Dinner Menu
whyItWorks: Both the rich Devil's Food Chocolate Cake and Warm Baked Apple Crisp with oat-butter crumble are citrus-free and nut-free (unlike the Rocky Road Sundae).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the Devil's Food Cake or Warm Apple Crisp with a Lactaid pill; skip the Rocky Road Sundae (chopped nuts).
watchOuts: Skip the Rocky Road Sundae on the same menu
